title: Ing Mawawala nang Hardin ning Kaunlaran
intro: King metung a gabun a mipanuanan king dakal a pibandyan, ing metung a komunidad miunlad ya, mabibie ya libutad ning tanda ning banal a grasya. Ing karelang kasaganaan metung yang testamento ning pabor ning karelang Ginu, metung a regalu a magsilbing inspirasyun ning kapasalamatan at kapamintuan. Pero, agyang malino ing karelang bendisyun, dinatang ing pamagbayu, a menagkat king karelang pamangilala king panibatan ning karelang maragul a pibandian at lingap.
clues: Mibendisyunan kami karing aduang hardin, ing metung king wanan at ing metung king kaili, a dakal a pupul.
Inutus na katamung mangan king probisyon ning Ginu tamu at magpasalamat kaya king mayap a gabun at mapagpatawad a Ginu.
Meging mayabang kami at tinalikuran mi ing dalan ning kapasalamatan, pagmaragul mi ing kekaming pibandian at upaya.
Inawad mi king Ginu mi na dagdagan na ing distansya ning kekaming pamaglakbe, papakit mi ing pamaglait king kapayapan a binie na.
Pepabaluan na kami ning metung a tubud, oneng e mi tinggap ing mensahi at sindu mi ing kekaming alang pansin.
Ing kekaming maragul a dam, na menatili keng kekaming kasaganaan, mesira ya, a meging sangkan ning makalunus a albug.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Metung a makasira a albug ibat keng mesira a dam
Ing pangalupig ning metung a mapang-api
trial.answer: Metung a makasira a albug ibat keng mesira a dam

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Mibayu kami keng unggoy ampo babi
Miligtas kami at mig migrate kami keng bayung gabun
Mikalat kami at meging alang tanaman ing gabun mi
Mitalakad tamung bayu, mas masagana a kayarian
outcome.answer: Mikalat kami at meging alang tanaman ing gabun mi

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
